refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights two CQs needing improvement: CQ5 (organization info extensibility) and CQ13 (file format validity/mandatory fields). High-priority: explicitly model file format validity requirements, possibly with OWL restrictions or SHACL. Medium-priority: enrich Organization with more extensible metadata (e.g., tax ID, contact info) or add OrganizationDetail class. Also, to improve quality, introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) for concepts like BuyerOrganization, and deepen the class hierarchy (e.g., subclasses for Organization and Item). Constraint adherence is good; no major violations. Pitfall history: recursive equivalentClass axiom for Invoice was removed, and all inverses are present. Plan: 1) Add OrganizationDetail class and link, plus new org properties (tax ID, contact info, etc.); 2) Add GCA for BuyerOrganization; 3) Add subclasses (Company, Supplier, Customer under Organization; Product, Service under Item); 4) Model file format validity with OWL restrictions (e.g., required properties on Invoice, Organization); 5) Ensure every property/class has annotation; 6) Validate and fix as needed.
